# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I see the bomb has a display showing 0, a yellow indicator light, and three wires: wire 1 is blue, wire 2 is red, and wire 3 is green.

Since I cannot hear, and Mute cannot speak, Mute can only send information to me via gestures, which Blind cannot see. Blind can hear my speech, so I will be the bridge between Mute's manual instructions and Blind's physical actions.

I will broadcast the full bomb state so Mute can consult the manual and Blind knows what is present. I will also establish a simple gesture code with Mute so they can unambiguously signal which action Blind should perform.

```
speak(text="Bomb status: DISPLAY is 0. LIGHT is yellow. WIRES: 1 is blue, 2 is red, 3 is green. Blind: tell us what components you can feel. Mute: consult the manual and gesture the instruction to me. Use ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, 🤟 for wire 3, or 👇 for pressing a button. I will speak your instruction to Blind.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The indicator light has changed from yellow to blue. The display still reads 0, and all three wires (1: blue, 2: red, 3: green) are intact.

I did not receive any gestures from Mute this round. I must alert Blind to hold off on blind actions, update everyone on the light change, and remind Mute to send gestures directed to me (or everyone) so I can read the manual's instructions and pass them along to Blind.

```
speak(text="LIGHT changed from yellow to blue! DISPLAY is still 0. WIRES: 1 is blue, 2 is red, 3 is green. Blind, please hold your actions. Mute, I saw no gestures from you. If you have instructions from the manual, send them via gesture to me: gesture(to='deaf', symbols=[...]). Reminders: ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, 🤟 for wire 3, 👇 for button.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

```
speak(text="URGENT PROTOCOL CHECK: Blind cannot see gestures. Deaf cannot hear speech. Mute cannot speak. The ONLY communication chain is: Mute reads manual -> Mute gestures to Deaf -> Deaf speaks instruction to Blind -> Blind operates bomb. Mute: you must use gesture(symbols=[...]) directed to Deaf or everyone! Bomb update: LIGHT was yellow, then blue, now WHITE. DISPLAY is 0. WIRES: 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]. Mute, tell me what Blind must do: ☝=cut wire 1, ✌=cut wire 2, 🤟=cut wire 3, 👇=press button, or spell out/point. Blind, wait for my explicit confirmation before touching anything!")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to immediately inform Mute and Blind of the new light state (RED), address the possibility that Mute has been targeting Blind with gestures (which Blind receives only as blanks), and provide clear instructions on how Mute must format the gesture call so I can relay it to Blind.

```
speak(text="BOMB STATUS: LIGHT is now RED! Sequence: T1 yellow -> T2 blue -> T3 white -> T4 red. DISPLAY: 0. WIRES: 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]. MUTE: Blind cannot see gestures. If you send with to='blind', I cannot see it and Blind only gets blanks! You MUST gesture to Deaf: gesture(to='deaf', symbols=['☝']) or gesture(symbols=['...']). ☝=wire 1, ✌=wire 2, 🤟=wire 3, 👇=button/other. BLIND: If you are hearing/feeling anything, or if Mute is sending you blanks, speak out loud! Mute can hear you.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[red] 3:[green]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤟]

Mute just sent the gesture: [🤟], which corresponds to wire 3 (the green wire).

Blind cannot see colors, so I must tell Blind explicitly to cut wire 3 / the third wire. I will also report the updated light status (purple) and confirm to Mute that the instruction is being relayed.

```
speak(text="BLIND: Mute gestured 🤟, which means CUT WIRE 3! Cut the third wire (wire 3). Light is currently PURPLE. Blind, perform the cut on wire 3 now! Mute, I received your gesture 🤟 and relayed it to Blind.")
```
